summary: A wide lifestyle banner shows the confirmed C1Splus scooter parked or paused outside a modern supermarket entrance. One adult woman is seated upright on the scooter, smiling toward camera, with one hand on the handlebar and the other raised in a wave. Two large kraft paper grocery bags with visible produce are placed inside the integrated middle cargo enclosure. The rear cargo basket appears empty. The scooter faces toward image-left and retains visible identity cues including black frame, step-through layout, middle cargo enclosure, rear basket, wide saddle, cyan-blue rim accents, blue rear coil suspension, visible brake discs, low front headlight, and a small cyan-blue circular marking on the lower steering stem.
